Bulletin No: 01 MWA/2026/06/02/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Strong Winds and Rough Seas
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 10.30 a.m. 02 June 2026
Valid for the period until 10.30 a.m. 03 June 2026.
For the sea areas extending from Mullaittivu to Pottuvil via
Kankasanthurai, Mannar, Puttalam, Colombo, Galle and
Hambantota.
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
The sea areas extending from
Mullaittivu to Pottuvil via
Kankasanthurai, Mannar, Puttalam,
Colombo, Galle and Hambantota will
be rough at times with strong gusty
winds up to (50-60) kmph.
The naval and fishing communities who
are engaged in fishing and naval
activities in the above sea areas are
requested to be vigilant in this regard.
